recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed unless a future ballot asks FHIR-I to change how date search handles fractional precision.
issue_request: FHIR-39484 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-I and requested clarification that date search parameter values may include fractional seconds by changing the format to yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ss.ssss[Z|(+|-)hh:mm] and saying fractional seconds may be ignored by servers.
initial_application: Commit f551573a484c66c7153bbe9454fbd6f019cbfa87 applied the request to source/search.html on 2023-03-19. Later commits 92f80e9f0e6f135227f474311cbbd67ff007bfd7 and a3766ac36c61fa3448d53aca0519dcbd874cfc93 removed the temporary TU marker and tagged the same rule as conformance text without changing its meaning.
additional_context: The linked Zulip implementer thread showed multiple implementations already accepted fractional seconds or safely ignored them. FHIR-I minutes record continued feedback collection on 2023-02-06 and a Persuasive 13-0-0 vote on 2023-02-27. A Jira FTS search for fractional seconds found only FHIR-39484, and publish.ini lists search.html as a built page.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html already contains the requested .ssss format and states that fractional seconds MAY be ignored by servers. The current wording is semantically equivalent to the approved proposal and is in build scope.
